description.message: Lanterna, the free assistant on your computer, reads pages and works in your browser: clicks, types and fills forms.

off_text.message: Start Lanterna on this computer: this panel connects to it by itself. The chats, the models and every decision stay in Lanterna; this extension only does in the browser what Lanterna asks.

reset_text.message: The Lanterna running on this computer isn't the one this extension was connected to before: it was set up again, or it's another copy. Connect only if you started it yourself.

pair_text.message: Lanterna is connected to another copy of this extension. In Lanterna, open Settings → Chrome and press «Connect Chrome»: this panel then connects by itself.
